name: Hermes Agent
postCreateCommand:
LOG=/tmp/hermes_setup.log
exec > >(tee "$LOG") 2>&1
echo "=== Setup started at $(date) ==="

# Wait for Docker daemon (DinD takes time)
echo "Waiting for Docker daemon..."
count=0
while ! docker info &>/dev/null; do
  count=$((count+1))
  echo "  attempt $count, sleeping 5s..."
  sleep 5
  if [ $count -gt 120 ]; then
    echo "Docker daemon never came up!"
    echo "DOCKER_FAIL" > /tmp/setup_status
    exit 0
  fi
done
echo "Docker ready after $((count*5))s"

# Start container
echo "Starting Hermes Agent..."
cd ${CODESPACE_VSCODE_FOLDER:-/workspaces/7Kmcdashou}
docker compose up -d 2>&1
echo "Waiting 15s for container..."
sleep 15
docker ps -a 2>&1

# Install hermes-web-ui (may fail, that is ok)
echo "Installing hermes-web-ui..."
npm install -g hermes-web-ui 2>&1 | tail -10

# Start hermes-web-ui
echo "Starting hermes-web-ui on 8648..."
nohup hermes-web-ui start 8648 --no-open >/dev/null 2>&1 &
sleep 5

# Report ports
echo "Listening ports:"
ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E "8648|9119" || echo "(no matching ports)"

echo "=== Setup finished at $(date) ==="
echo SETUP_DONE > /tmp/setup_status
